subject: PeakDay demo — peak-day traffic sample & quick qual
messages:
From: Alex Li <alex@peakday.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: PeakDay trial — quick question about demo & peak-day traffic sample

Hi Monica,

I signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday (PeakDay Analytics) and wanted to get a short demo to make sure Redwood will meet our peak-day needs before we invite engineering. We have a single primary use case: real-time product recommendations + a lightweight chat assistant for customers.

Quick context: our traffic pattern is very spiky — about 80% of requests occur in a 3-hour window on sales days. I attached a small CSV sample of request counts by hour from last month. Two quick questions before we book:

- Do you typically recommend a single model variant for peak bursts or a fallback routing strategy?
- What throughput and concurrency numbers should we expect to show in a short demo to validate latency at peak?

Would appreciate a 20–30 minute slot next week — we can keep it high level.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Li
Head of ML Engineering, PeakDay Analytics
alex@peakday.ai

Attachment: traffic_snapshot.csv (text/csv)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex@peakday.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PeakDay trial — quick question about demo & peak-day traffic sample

Thanks Alex — and welcome to Redwood. Quick note: Ben (cc) is our SDR who handles the initial onboarding touchpoints; he'll help coordinate the calendar. I reviewed the CSV you attached — that spike profile is exactly the sort of pattern we see a lot, so we can definitely run a focused demo that demonstrates both steady-state and spike behavior.

Before we lock a slot can you confirm a few details so we tailor the demo: 

1) Primary workload: recommendation scoring + customer chat (is chat synchronous conversational or mostly single-turn prompts?)
2) Typical request shape: avg token length per request and 95th percentile token length (if unsure, ballpark is fine)
3) Peak concurrency estimate (requests per second during your 3-hour window) and any concurrent background embedding QPS for search
4) Timeline: pilot dates and target production go-live (helps us decide whether to demo Dedicated options vs hosted)
5) Any compliance/data residency requirements (EU/US/other) or SSO needed for your team access

If you can shoot back short bullets we'll propose 2–3 compact slots (20–30m). Attaching a short one-pager that explains the typical demo agenda and what we can validate in 30 minutes.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

On Fri, Oct 8, 2026 at 9:45 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Alex — and welcome to Redwood. Quick note: Ben (cc) is our SDR who handles the initial onboarding touchpoints; he'll help coordinate the calendar. I reviewed the CSV you attached — that spike profile is exactly the sort of pattern we see a lot, so we can definitely run a focused demo that demonstrates both steady-state and spike behavior.
> 
> Before we lock a slot can you confirm a few details so we tailor the demo: 

Hi Monica — thanks for the quick response. Answers below (short bullets as requested):

- Primary workload: 70% recommendation scoring (small stateless calls), 30% customer chat. Chat is mostly single-turn prompts with occasional short-context threads (~3 messages max).
- Request sizes: average ~420 tokens, 95th percentile ~1,100 tokens (we send product context + user text).
- Peak concurrency: roughly 450 concurrent requests at peak; estimated sustained peak ~60 requests/s and short bursts to 120 req/s.
- Embeddings: background indexing for search ~18k QPS/day (batched), real-time search queries at peak ~150 QPS.
- Timeline: pilot window starting Nov 8, production goal mid-Q1 2027.
- Compliance: US-based data only for now; no special SSO needed for the demo.

Proposed demo slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 12 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Oct 13 — 14:00–14:30 PT

Attaching the CSV snapshot from our telemetry (stripped of PII). If any of the numbers look off for a demo let me know and we can tighten the sample.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Li
Head of ML Engineering, PeakDay Analytics

- 5m quick introductions + pilot goals
